security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives caused by Markdown code fences, localhost example settings, and placeholder .env.example values. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, hidden network behavior, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: Example secrets use realistic variable names in .env.example.
remediation.suggestion: Keep only placeholder values and add guidance that users must generate unique local secrets before deployment.

remediation.issue: Shell setup examples may be mistaken for automatically executed commands.
remediation.suggestion: Label command blocks as examples and ask the agent to confirm before running scaffold commands in a user workspace.

content.value_statement: Starting a Python project often requires many repeated setup decisions. This skill creates consistent scaffolds for APIs, Django apps, libraries, and CLI tools.
actual_capabilities: Selects a project shape for FastAPI, Django, library, CLI, or generic Python applications.
Outlines directory structures with source packages, tests, configuration files, and documentation.
Provides pyproject.toml guidance for dependencies, optional dev tools, Ruff, and pytest.
Includes starter FastAPI and Typer CLI patterns for common entry points.
Defines development support files such as .gitignore, .env.example, and Makefile tasks.
limitations: It provides scaffold guidance and examples, not a verified generated repository by itself.
Dependency versions may need review against current package releases.
Generated examples require project-specific names, settings, and deployment changes.
It does not replace security review for production secrets, authentication, or infrastructure settings.

use_cases.title: Create a New API Service
use_cases.description: Generate a FastAPI layout with routing, settings, models, schemas, tests, and developer commands.

use_cases.title: Start a Python Package
use_cases.description: Build a library scaffold with src layout, packaging metadata, type markers, tests, and lint settings.

use_cases.title: Standardize Internal Tools
use_cases.description: Create CLI or generic application templates that share uv, pytest, Ruff, and Makefile conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Project Scaffold
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small application.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Python project scaffold for a small command-line utility. Include the folder structure, dependencies, tests, and setup steps.

prompt_templates.title: FastAPI Service Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Scaffold a FastAPI service using uv, Python 3.11 or newer, pytest, Ruff, settings management, health checks, and versioned API routes.

prompt_templates.title: Package With Type Safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Python library scaffold with src layout, pyproject.toml metadata, py.typed, pytest tests, Ruff, mypy guidance, and release notes.

prompt_templates.title: Production Team Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production-ready Python scaffold for a team service. Include architecture choices, dev commands, test strategy, configuration boundaries, and deployment preparation notes.

output_examples.input: Scaffold a FastAPI service for user profiles.
output_examples.output: A structured service plan with app package layout, API routers, settings, database modules, test folders, pyproject dependencies, and setup commands.

output_examples.input: Create a reusable Python package template.
output_examples.output: A package scaffold description with src layout, typed package marker, project metadata, development dependencies, tests, and documentation sections.

output_examples.input: Build a CLI project starter with uv.
output_examples.output: A CLI scaffold outline with command entry point, Typer and Rich dependencies, tests, formatting tools, and repeatable Makefile tasks.

best_practices: Provide the target project type, Python version, package name, and deployment context before generation.
Review placeholder configuration values before using the scaffold in production.
Run tests, linting, and formatting after creating files from the scaffold.
anti_patterns: Do not commit real secrets when replacing .env.example placeholders.
Do not accept dependency versions without checking compatibility for your project.
Do not use the same scaffold unchanged for every application type.

faq.question: What project types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It covers FastAPI services, Django applications, Python libraries, CLI tools, and generic Python applications.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: It provides complete scaffold guidance and examples. File creation depends on the host tool and user approval flow.

faq.question: Which package manager does it prefer?
faq.answer: The skill centers on uv for project initialization, dependency management, and virtual environments.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata marks the skill as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are the .env values safe to publish?
faq.answer: The provided values are placeholders. Replace them locally and never commit real secrets.

faq.question: Does it include testing guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes pytest structure and configuration guidance for generated project templates.
